review_basis: Four-position byte-bound contact-sheet review of all 41 twelve-second clips. Thirty-five clips passed; six clips are rejected for cinematic or claim-semantic reasons and must be replaced without altering the approved thirty-five footage byte streams.

overrides.reason: The blue synthetic hacking interface looked like a low-cost science-fiction overlay and did not provide a credible physical analogue for agentic cyber operations.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A real technical team reviewing code and system activity gives the agentic-espionage narration a credible human-operator context while the attributed provider report carries every factual claim.

overrides.reason: The stadium corridor crowd did not represent ordinary shared urban life and would misstate the narration's distributed social consequences.
overrides.semantic_rationale: Diverse pedestrians moving through an ordinary public city street return the consequences of concentrated AI decisions to a credible everyday human scale.

overrides.reason: The green hacker-screen imagery was a visual cliché and could be mistaken for proof of an attack rather than defensive cyber operations context.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A real monitoring team in a control-room environment supports the defensive side of the dual-use cyber argument without reenacting a named attack or presenting stock footage as evidence.

overrides.reason: The previous shot prominently combined Swiss and EU flags and was misleading in a section specifically about EU AI Act designation rules.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A clearly European Union flag on an institutional building locates the legal-designation discussion without introducing a non-EU national symbol; the regulation page remains the direct evidence.

overrides.reason: The previous computer screen visibly showed a sales-customer interface and was unrelated to independent technical evaluation or audit.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A diverse professional team critically reviewing documents and data represents independent evaluation and human judgment without implying that the stock material is an actual audit record.

overrides.reason: The classroom-style technology-business presentation lacked the authority and visual quality required for incident reporting and formal oversight.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A formal group reviewing documents provides credible reporting, governance and oversight context without inventing a named hearing, regulator or incident.
